notes.title: Update Notes for Patch 2.31
notes.notes:
Hey Dreadlanders!

Time for a new patch! 
With this patch we introduce armor traits, some new items with fire and overall improving the Quality of Life in the game. We hope you enjoy it!

Added traits to armor

  Thorns (chance to proc poison on melee hit)
  Spikes (damage on melee hit)
  Shroud (-10% ranged hit chance)
  Overdrive (chance to proc Overdrive buff on hit) 
  Regen (chance to proc Heal over Time on hit)
  Hemostasis (First bleed is negated)
  Retribution  (chance to be inspired on hit)
  Grit (increased chance to resist pinning)

Note: Armor can't be upgraded in the workshop yet but this will be added in the next patch

New Weapon Traits

 Incendiary, give a 35% chance on hit to set the target on fire 
 Firestarter, give a 100% chance on hit to set the target on fire (Only on Epic weapons) 


New Items

 Added Igniter Grenade (fire grenade)
 Igniter Grenades fire stays for 3 turns


New Mechanics

 Fire now stay on ground and applies burn to anyone who passes through it
 Flamethrower fire now stays on ground for 1 turn


Quality Of Life improvements

 Loot boxes can now be opened anywhere, you no longer need to bring them back to your workshop
 Throwing a grenade a short distance will now scatter less. 
 Short throw is 4 squares or less
 You can now make the fighter move towards the mouse cursor by keeping it pressed (outside combat) 
 Touch up on shoot lines and move lines to make them look nicer
 Made it more clear when a fighter is affected by the “Click” debuff and next shot will jam the weapon
 Fighters can now Overwatch when pinned


Fixes

 Fixed issue with checking melee weapon traits instead of ranged when shooting while standing next to a downed enemy.
 Fixed issue with challenge "Fair Fight" and Scrap Mines / Leg Trap failing the challenge
 Fixed issue with escaping Wellspring dungeon
 Fixed issue when interaction with two different interactions at the same time
 Fixed bug with grenades causing them to scatter more often than intended
 Fixed issue with a fighter throwing 2 grenades in the same turn
 Fixed issue with exit in Flannerys Ford
 Fixed issue with selling Glow Stim Packs with right click
 Fixed rare crash when opening two facilites in the base at the same time
 Small fixes to dialogs
 Graphical fix for complete contracts dialog
 Removed pick lock from workshop since loot boxes can now be opened anywhere
 Fixed some issues with renaming fighters outside your hideout
 Challenges ui is now properly displayed in tutorial 2: attack the hideout
 Pistol and dual pistol Overwatch animation now uses correct animation
 Overwatch is removed when soldier is panicked
 Fixed rare crash with bear traps
 Fixed rare crash in the level up screen
 Fixed some Overwatch from full cover issues
 Removed unjam message at the end of mission
 Fixed some missing localization
 Fixed rare crash when forming a coop group
 Fixed crash when opening a Lootbox with full gang inventory


Tweaks

 Adjusted enemy gear
 Adjusted glow price for rare and epic (lowered slightly)
 Turret will now autoequip its ranged weapon after a melee fight is over


Stay Safe!
/Dreadlands Crew

notes.title: Big Pre-release Patch
notes.notes:
Dreadlands will be fully Released on Monday 9th of November! But as a reward for your support, we wanted to release the Full Release additions and changes a little early for you to enjoy.
With your continued support we can keep the Dreadlands evolving and changing, but from all of us on the Dreadlands team, thank you for your incredible support thus far!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823900/888a44ba4616b7ed780b1ff7c2216c576b918ce8.png

Big additions
 Added the Skarbacks faction!
 Added final missions in the main campaign and updated the “Daybreak Dawn” contract. (If you completed “Daybreak Dawn” prior, speak to Tanner in Shacktown to continue the story)
 Base Management has been fully added. Access your workshop to increase the functionality of your Hideout.


Special Bonus
You will unlock a Top Hat cosmetic for the Scrapper Mechanic if you download the patch and play this weekend. Otherwise you will have to beat the upcoming Dreadlands Demo to unlock it.

General Gameplay changes
 Smoothed out the difficulty curve in the beginning of the game.
 Set the starting credits when you create a gang with only a leader to 350 credits.
 Rebalanced contract rewards. 
 Rebalanced enemy loot drops. Enemies now also have a small chance of dropping gear and Glow.
 Increased Medical Supply loot drops and settlement Doctors now have more of them.
 Merchants can now occasionally carry Scrap Metal and Glow.
 Updated the second tutorial map so the enemy has less Full Cover.
 Reduced the cost of Rare and Epic weapons.
 Changed so Glow Hunts won’t appear until Fame rank 3.
 Added 2 new Dungeon and Glow Hunt enemy gangs. Glow Diggers and Cult of Glow.
 Reduced the higher Medical Supply cost a bit at your Medical Center. 
 Improved level design in some levels.
 Adjusted how to-hit is calculated in combat. It should now feel less random.


Skill & Class balance changes
General
 Liver Strike = Now has a 5 turn cooldown instead.
 Hamstring = Now triggers on melee hits instead of Critical hits.
 Cripping shots = Applies -2 movement on Critical hit.
 Harass = Now has a 3 turn cooldown instead.
 Bash = Now has a 2 turn cooldown instead.
 Medic = Heal increased from 1 to 2.
 Sadist = Also applies when target is Burning.
 Command = Is now a Free Action.


Scrappers
 Glow Spark Engine = Fixed so it’s a Free Action to use. Increase melee to-hit bonus from 10% to 15%.
 Fragile Arm Boosters = To-hit bonus increased from 15% to 20%.
 Risk Aversion = Reduces chance of gun jamming by 35% instead of +5% To-hit. 


Rust Blades
 Rust Poison = Now has a 6 turn cooldown instead.
 Viper = Now reduces Rust Poison cooldown to 4 turns.


Engineers
 Tinker = duration and cooldown to 4 turns. Tinker now also gives a +15% to-hit bonus with ranged attacks.
 Master Engineer = Reduces Tinker cooldown to 2 turns.


Tribe-kin
Rangers
 Ranger’s Mark = Increased cooldown from 3 to 4. 
 Master Hawker = Reduces Ranger’s Mark cooldown to 3 turns.


Beasts
 Carnivore = Heal increased from 1-2 to 1-3 HP.
 Shake it off = Now has a 5 turn cooldown instead.


Visual & audio changes
 Several updates to the game’s UI.
 Added faction theme music at Fame up and at faction creation.


Technical fixes
 Fix for Coop crash in Wellspring
 Fix for occasional Coop crash at Traders
 Fix for Bomb Rats crash in Coop
 Fix for crash when inspecting Enemies
 Wisecrackers and Wild-Kin Tribe enemies now behaves properly


Thanks for your ongoing support and we’ll see you in the Dreadlands!
// The Dreadlands team

notes.title: Small technical and gameplay update
notes.notes:
With this patch we wanted to mainly focus on fixing some technical issues players were experiencing. But we've also included some smaller balance tweaks and gameplay additions that will be expanded upon further with the release of the game.

Gameplay changes
General
 AI won’t be as eager to execute Downed fighters anymore.
 Beasts are more aggressive and don’t sit in cover as much.
 Ambush mission reworked. The Ambusher can now only attack from two sides and have to deploy their units first.
 The Spitter enemy’s Poison spit attack no longer causes pinning and needs line of sight.
 Help Compendium has been added. It will contain various handy information about how the game plays. Work in Progress and more will be added prior to release.
 Base Management for the Hideout has been added. Work in Progress and will be expanded upon prior to release.
 Added additional loot drops for enemies. This should result in more credits and worthwhile battles.
 Reduced starting Gang size from 5 to 4 fighters.
 Scrap metal: Cost increased from 5 to 15 credits.
 Updated Event trader inventory so they have a more well-rounded selection of items.


Scrappers
 Bomb Rats Tactic now explode on turn 2 or 3 and now ignores Downed fighters.
 Rust Blade: Reduced base hire cost by 20 credits. Increased movement from 4 to 5.
 Engineer: Turret now has the Burst trait (giving it a 25% chance of hitting missed attacks at reduced damage) and +10% to-hit short range


Tribe-kin
 Ranger: Health reduced from 5 to 4.
 Totem Heal radius decreased slightly and now has a 4 turn lifetime.


Visual changes
 New tooltip UI


Technical fixes
 Fix for occasional Coop crash when starting a mission
 Fix for occasional Coop crash when starting a party
 Fix for occasional Coop crash when entering a settlement
 Fix for Collect Contracts not triggering when picking up contract items
 Potential fix for rare Worldmap crash
 Tribe-kin Bears now drop Bear meat instead of Dog Meat (turns out Bears don’t think dogs are very tasty!).


Thanks for your ongoing support and feedback!
// The Dreadlands team

notes.title: Glowing Dawn Patch
notes.notes:
Hello Dreadlanders!
This time we've got another big patch for you, so strap yourselves in.
We’d love to hear what you think about it in the comments or over in our Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823900/41f85751075a40c28bf7a8fcc87216fb9a558ea2.gif

Big additions & changes:

Co-op mode
You can now play Dreadlands together with another player, regardless of which faction you play as.
Access Co-op through the Multiplayer button in the bottom right corner during play.

Endless Dungeon
The Endless Dungeon “Wellspring” has been unlocked in the Gauntglow region.
Fight against increasingly more difficult enemies and Bosses in pursuit of Glow. Keep an eye out for the mad glow merchant and their rare wares!
Find Unstable Glow and stabilize it at every 5th floor to bring your spoils back to the surface.

World Map Events
Randomly spawning Events have been added. You won’t know what they are unless you check…
Traders: Traders with higher quality wares.
Enemies: Sometimes you can come across various gangs and beasts, except you can now get the drop on them!
Glow Hunts: Delve into underground cave systems in search of Glow. Be careful though, there’s risk attached to the reward! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823900/f0ce270b1b2b0bb1e32154d60d51f4fd916a294f.png

General updates:
Steam Achievements
Added 35 Steam Achievements

Frames & Player profile
Unlockable Gang Logo Frames have been added. You can see the ones you own, equip new ones and see how to unlock more under your Player profile. Access this by clicking on your Gang Logo in the top left corner of the screen.
Achievements are also tied to these unlocks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823900/45126961ab90d8e9f737ce94946a51af2946797a.png

Fast travel
At Fame level 4 you unlock the option to call in an airship to Fast Travel back to your Hideout.

Weapon & Tactics cards crafting
You can now upgrade your weapons or re-roll their traits at your Hideout’s workshop.
Craft any Tactics cards at the Tactics Table in your Hideout. 

Glow economy
With the addition of the Glow currency, certain new and old things now require you to spend Glow.
Buying rare or epic gear will for example now require an additional sum of Glow.

Gameplay:
New enemy: Spitter
The beasts of the Dreadlands are ever mutating. Beasts capable of spitting toxic phlegm across great distances have been spotted all across the Dreadlands.

Overwatch has been updated to allow for a more free aim.

The Flamer has been updated to use a cone attack.

The Flame Pistol has been added, which functions as a weaker Flamer, but can still be dual-wielded.

The option to try to escape from Roaming enemies on the map has been added, as well as the option to Bribe them with Glow to avoid fighting them entirely.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823900/3dfc027a26d63caef80c24addbe63ab5813b2885.png

Visuals:
Updated UI.
Updated visuals for the World Map.
Updated lighting to several parts of the game.
The ability to adjust the Gamma has been added under the Options menu.
 

Thanks for your continued support & feedback!
// The Dreadlands team

notes.title: Tempered Steel Update is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Greetings Dreadlanders!

The team has been working hard to crank this massive update out for you and we hope you think it was worth the wait! Let us know in the comments what you think or join our Discord Channel to talk to use directly. 



Gameplay
Leveling & XP
 Each unit now has their own skill tree (includes passive & active skills) with over 70 new skills. 
 Max level is now Lv 6.
 XP required to level up has been lowered.
 All units now have their own starting skills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823900/4c4cdc1d6d823542fc5315d39c5a7c425f2afd39.png

Units have additional skills
All units now have class specific passive and/or active skills. For example Leader units now have "Command" and Rust Blades now have "Rust Poison".

Expanded merchant inventories
Merchant now have expanded inventories of weapons and armor. Additional weapons and armor will be unlocked as your Fame increases.

Added Heavy weapons & Flamethrower
2 new Heavy weapons the Hellion and Warmonger has been added, as well the Flamethrower.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823900/54a05521a18631cab053efe14ea0aaa97140d500.png

Item changes
 Items are no longer consumed on use (apart from Glow Stims). Meaning they are only consumed in-battle and are then restored to use in the next battle.
 Antidote renamed to Stim-Pack. Stim-Pack cures Poison and Burn debuffs.
 Repair-kits can now restore 1 armor point in combat.
 Ammo renamed Ammo Pack. Can no longer be crafted at the Workshop.
 Unit inventory size is now reduced from 6 to 4. [Items equipped in the removed slots will be moved to the Gang Inventory, or if it's full, to the Stash]


Bleed & Poison reworked
 Poison can now be applied by weapons with "Poison" (35% chance) or "Toxin" (100% chance).
 All weapons no longer have a chance to apply Bleed, now only weapons with "Bleed" (35% chance) or "Rend" (100% chance) can do so.
 Bleed will now only damage the unit by 1 if they use more than 1AP on their turn.


Re-balanced weapons
 Most weapons have been re-balanced to make them more unique and balanced.
 Aim has been changed to Aimed Shot. It is now an active ability that costs 2AP to use that gives the same bonus to-hit.
 Burst weapons can now use Aimed Shot.


Formation system more flexible
Formations now only have 2 restrictions. That your Slot points don't go beyond the max and that you don't field more than 10 units total.
This allows for much greater freedom in what units to bring into combat.

Improved level design
The levels now have increased amounts of cover.

To-hit cap removed & cover changes
 There is no longer any to-hit cap. Meaning to-hit can reach 100%.
 To compensate for this, Full Cover reduces ranged weapon damage by 1.


Combat Challenges & MVP
 8 additional combat challenges added that will rotate.
 MVP now rewards additional XP.


Exiting mid-combat changes
Exiting combat now won't result in an Injury penalty. Instead you won't keep any XP and items gained during the combat if you exit the game or to the menu.

Misc changes
 Dual wielding melee weapons now give -15% to-hit.
 Dual wielding one handed ranged weapons gives -30% to-hit
 Units can now only counter attack once per turn.
 Added Height Advantage +15% to-hit chance if above target.


Visuals
 Improved the lighting in several parts of the game.
 Improved the look of the Scrapper and Tribe-kin Hideouts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823900/6bf100398018c23201d77184d8c045490483a0d0.png

Sound
 Added additional combat, hideout and ambient music to the game.
 Added additional voices to units.


UI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823900/bdf0f373a2db86137ec19f1f53cc163d1840879c.png
 Visually improved across several parts of the game.
 Redesigned the Inventory & stat screens.
  Overworld map now has additional quick access buttons.
 The main menu now has the "Settings" menu button.
 Weapon traits descriptions are now visible on mouse over.
 Available Contracts and the Hideout is now marked out on the map.
 Implemented class icons to see which unit is which easier.




Thank you for your continued support and feedback.
See you in the Dreadlands!
// The Dreadlands team

notes.title: Next Update: Tempered Steel
notes.notes:
Hello Dreadlanders!
We’ve been hard at work on the next patch and this is a big one! 
The plan is to get it out to you very soon, but to tide you over let’s look at just some of the bigger changes coming in the next patch.

Leveling and skill trees
We’ve reworked how leveling works and given each unit their own skill tree with both passive and active skills. The goal is to make leveling up your units more fun and interesting, while also making each unit feel more unique.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823900/4c4cdc1d6d823542fc5315d39c5a7c425f2afd39.png

Guns guns guns!
We’ve rebalanced most weapons to help make them feel more unique. But to spice things up even more we’re also throwing heavy weapons and flamethrowers into the mix!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823900/54a05521a18631cab053efe14ea0aaa97140d500.png

We’ve done a big UI pass across the board to not only make it look nicer, but also flow better.

Hope you’re as excited as we are about the upcoming patch and let us know in the comments what you think!

notes.title: Content and Quality Of Life patch
notes.notes:
Hello Dreadlanders!
The second content patch is now live!
With this patch we wanted to focus on improving the Quality of Life in the game, while also doing some smaller visual and gameplay tweaks.
We also added a highly requested feature, Custom Names for your units and your Gang, as well as 2 new Tactics cards.

Custom Names
We’ve added the option to set your own custom Gang and Fighter names yourselves! 
Every Gang and Fighter will have an online name and a custom personal name. By default you will see your own custom names and everyone else will see the online name. But if you want to see what your fellow Dreadlanders calls their Gangs and Fighters, you can easily toggle this in the game’s Settings menu.

Quality Of Life improvements
 Armor has been reworked. It will no longer need to be repaired in-between fights.
Instead to temporarily destroy armor in combat you need to use explosives or weapons with “Shred”. Another weapon trait “Pierce” allows the weapon to ignore 1 point of armor when dealing damage. 
 Scrap Metal and Medical supplies will now be transferred from your Gang Inventory to your Gang Resource bar directly after each fight, freeing up inventory space.
 After a battle if you press "End Mission" the game will automatically collect all the loot on the battlefield and allow you to pick and choose what you want to keep.
 Added rigged "Tanner Boxes" that can appear on the battlefield. They contain high value loot, but will randomly spawn and explode after 3 turns. 
(Tanner has stashes hidden across the Dreadlands, but has rigged them to blow to prevent theft. If he can't have it, then no one can!)
 Changed so Aim is now a toggle, so you can undo the Aim command.
 All enemies now have an equal chance of dropping loot no matter if they're Downed, Out of Action or Executed.


New tactics
Scrap prison
Deploys a Scrap Prison around a Fighter. The target is immune to damage but can’t act for 1 turn.

Inversion
For 2 turns Bleed and Poison will now heal the target, while any Healing will harm them.

Other fixes
 The camera can no no longer infinitely drift away in combat, settlements, etc.  
 Reloading with a melee weapon equipped will now properly reload the units weapon.
 Added missing description texts for items without one.
 Fixed so "Vagabond" has the correct weapon model.
 Changed the name of "Unstable Med-Station" to MediGlow Station.
 Workshop crash fix
 Overview crash fix

notes.title: Content and balancing Patch
notes.notes:
We are now adding content patches every other week. Our goal is to set them live every other Thursday. The first patch is all about balancing and some additional goodies. 

Ranged vs Melee balancing
Main purpose of this content patch is to make melee and ranged combat a little bit more balanced. We are also aiming to make Goons, Scouts, Dogs and Boars to be more relevant and fun. As always we would really like your feedback on this changes. 

 Rookies are now called Skirmishers and will have a more defined role as a fast but weak attack unit.
 Scouts/Goons melee skill increased from 2 to 3. Scouts/Goons also gets the Gunslinger skill (see below)
 All excepts Skirmishers will have their movement reduced to 4. 
 Charging will no longer give an extra attack, only +1 to melee skill.


New tactic cards
We've added two new Tactic cards in this content patch. To Unlock them, just enter your Hideout between today and until the next Content Patch (in roughly 2 weeks time). After that you will have to Unlock them normally by increasing your in-game Fame.

Scrap Vulture (Scrappers)
Any time the target deals melee damage they will restore their armor by 1.
lasts 3 turns

Spore skin (Tribe-kin)
Every time the unit is hit they exude a cloud of spores that makes them -15% harder to hit for that turn (stacks up to 2x times). Spore skin lasts 2 turns.

Addtional patch notes
Gameplay

 Revived fighters only get 1 ap after being revived.
 Animals can now use bandages.
 The amount of medical supplies needed to heal a fighter is now based on their level. Lower level fighters wont require as many medical supplies.
 Grenades no longer counts as shots.
 Added Gunslinger skill. Decreases the penalty for dual wielding pistols.
 Improved how the RNG for to-hit works.


Visual

 Added Show Gore option. Turn this off for less bloody executions.
 Remove blurriness for combat overview (pressing shift during combat).
 Fixed visual issues on lots of levels.
 Reworked Frankian Hills layout on world map.
 New icons for the Tank skill and Glow Stim Pack.
 Added healthbar status icons on most buffs and debuffs.
 New weapon model for the sniper rifle
 Added a Band-aid icon on the Light Wound icon to indicate how many missions the fighter must rest until recovered. It's also shown in the tool tip for the Light Wound. 


Technical

 Fix for inventory crash
Fix for workshop crash
